user.title: Connect to Baby Tracker
user.description: Enter your Baby Tracker sync account. Home Assistant joins it as its own device.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to Baby Tracker again
reauth_confirm.description: Baby Tracker rejected the saved password for {email}. It may have been changed in the app.

abort.already_configured: This Baby Tracker account is already configured

data_description.feeding_overdue_hours: 0 uses the baby's age: 3.5 hours for a newborn, up to 6 hours for older babies.
data_description.low_wet_minimum: Low Wet Diapers turns on after 8 pm when the baby has fewer than this many.
data_description.fever_threshold: In the unit chosen above. Leave blank for 100.4 F (38.0 C).

sleep_source.title: Sleep source and tracking for {baby}
sleep_source.description: Record {baby}'s sleep from another entity, such as a Snoo, an Owlet or a bed sensor. Leave the entity empty to log sleep by hand only. Below, choose which activities are still logged for {baby}: alerts and predictions for the others go quiet.

data.sleep_gap_minutes: A wake shorter than this does not end the sleep (minutes)
data.sleep_min_minutes: Never log a sleep shorter than this (minutes)

data_description.sleep_source_asleep_states: Check the entity's states in Developer Tools rather than guessing. Type a value and press Enter to add it.
data_description.tracked_activities: Auto counts an activity as tracked when it was logged in the last 14 days (every activity for a baby under 14 days old). Pick activities to set them by hand instead.

error.invalid_fever_threshold: That fever temperature isn't sensible for the chosen units (95-110 F or 35-43 C)
error.no_asleep_states: Choose at least one state that means asleep

old_www_folder.title: Old baby photos are publicly readable
old_www_folder.description: Older versions saved baby photos in {folder}, where anyone on your network can open them at /local/baby_tracker/ without logging in. Baby photos are now kept privately and shown by the Photo image entities, so those copies are no longer used. Delete the folder to remove them.

uploads_pending.title: Baby Tracker records aren't reaching the server
uploads_pending.description: {count} record(s) logged in Home Assistant have not been uploaded to the Baby Tracker server for several updates in a row. They are kept and will be sent once the server accepts them. Check your internet connection and that the Baby Tracker service is up; the Sync Now button tries again.

account_reset.title: Baby Tracker account was reset
account_reset.description: The Baby Tracker account was reset or recreated, so the data kept in Home Assistant belongs to the old group and syncing has stopped. Press the Force Resync button (or call the baby_tracker.force_resync service) to rejoin the group. Records that were never uploaded are discarded.

custom_sentences.title: Install the Baby Tracker voice commands

confirm.title: Install the Baby Tracker voice commands
confirm.description:
Home Assistant only reads Assist sentences from {folder}. Select Submit to write the Baby Tracker sentence file there, with your babies' names filled in, so you can say things like "Everly had a wet diaper" or "when did Everly last eat". An existing baby_tracker.yaml in that folder is replaced.

The conversation agent is asked to reload the sentences. If a command is not recognised straight away, restart Home Assistant.

error.write_failed: The sentence file could not be written. Check the Home Assistant log, and that the configuration folder is writable.

abort.no_entry: No Baby Tracker account is set up
